summary: Prisma v1.3 (iteration 5) — testing OS custom_fields/recurrence/templates/send, public portal (get/related/sign/checkout/receipt), task time tracking. Backend: 17/17 pytest passing (test_iteration_5_prisma_v13.py). Frontend: /app/os renders and Nova OS dialog + recurrence toggle + '+ campo' + save-tpl-<id> button + send-os work; OSPublica portal end-to-end sign + receipt + pay button confirmed; Projetos page timer start/stop persists total_seconds and open-task-<id> opens TaskDetail modal with Custom Fields + manual minutes input. ONE HIGH-priority UI bug found: on /app/os the 'Link' button (copy-link-<id>) uses navigator.clipboard.writeText WITHOUT catching the returned promise. On insecure/permission-denied contexts this triggers an unhandled promise rejection, which surfaces the CRA runtime error overlay, blocking all further clicks (including save-tpl dialog) on the page.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText(url) is called without .catch/try. When the browser denies the Clipboard permission (any non-user-gesture, iframes, or preview environment), an unhandled promise rejection is thrown ('Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied') and the CRA runtime error overlay covers the entire page, blocking further UI (e.g., save-tpl-<id> dialog does not open, all buttons are hidden behind the red overlay). Fix: wrap in try/catch and fallback to document.execCommand('copy') or show toast on failure. Toast 'Link do portal copiado' is shown but the promise still rejects.

action_items: OrdemServico.jsx copyLink: change `navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);` to `try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url); toast.success(...); } catch { /* fallback via textarea+execCommand OR just show toast */ }`. This unblocks save-as-template UI flow and eliminates the CRA overlay in prod-like environments where Clipboard API is restricted.

rca of the issue: OrdemServico.jsx line 136-140 defines copyLink(o) => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(url); toast.success('Link do portal copiado.') }. In secure origins with user gesture the writeText resolves. In this preview environment (Playwright headless / cross-origin / no explicit permission) the returned Promise rejects, but since there is no .catch and it's not awaited inside try/catch, React's unhandled rejection handler surfaces the CRA dev overlay ('Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied'). The overlay is z-index max and covers ALL page content, causing any subsequent click (e.g. save-tpl-<id>) to fail. Reproduce: /app/os → click any copy-link-<id> → red overlay appears. Fix: `try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url); } catch (e) { /* toast fallback */ }`. Same pattern should be audited for OSPublica.jsx and other pages if similar copy actions exist.
